items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury and limited/no practice; earlier optimism confirmed.
items.why: Felt better Saturday; sources optimistic no setbacks.
items.implication: Full or near-full workload expected; WR1 lock if limited volume risk low.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary option with Adams OUT.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins after GTD/pessimism and limited practice returning from quad; unlikely earlier reports confirmed.
items.why: Not full participant yet; bit early in recovery from 3-game absence.
items.implication: Continue sit; handcuff/backup RB elevated for full role.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT after earlier QUESTIONABLE designation for Week 7 vs Bengals (high ankle sprain); Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; missed prior two games.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; Huntley streamer/spot start; Ravens skill upside limited without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos backfield snap share 50%, rush share 41%, route participation 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps. Pre-season love confirmed; roster in 100% leagues.
items.implication: Priority add/start candidate; Dobbins demoted in committee.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries/routes expansion; clear lead back path.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but not certain on severity; was expected lead back pre-game.
items.why: Post-game assessment; hamstring noted in ETR watch.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible limited role or sit next week; Tracy also hamstring.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if self-inflicted serious injury while not scoring.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no major concern post-game.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue RB1 usage next week.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (Q but expected) for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Smith hamstring, Wicks ankle per reports/injury report.
items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; Saquon volume secure if active; TE/backup WR upside.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining pass-catchers and Saquon checkdowns if limited.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play/IN after exempt list; multiple other activations (Mason, Coleman, Dell, Kirk).
items.implication: Immediate RB1 role return; monitor snap share post-layoff.

items.text: Vikings RB Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday win not significant; source day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely available next week; minimal long-term concern. Monitor Mason role.

items.text: Chiefs WR routes without Rashee Rice (2nd game): Xavier Worthy 33 of 36 Mahomes dropbacks; career high routes but never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games.
items.why: Rice out hamstring; Worthy clear WR1 routes.
items.implication: Ceiling capped historically despite volume; volatile WR2/flex.
items.opportunity: Route/target share spike with Rice absent.
items.conflict: High routes but low historical production ceiling.

items.text: Jets WR routes with AD Mitchell back (33 Geno dropbacks): Garrett Wilson 29, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts season on 52 routes), Mitchell 18.
items.implication: Wilson still lead; Cooper deep threat/rosterable in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Cooper route share and efficiency upside.

items.text: Post-Sunday injuries watching: Gibbs ankle (slide), CMC quad (returned), Waddle shoulder, Aaron Jones knee, Skattebo/Tracy hamstring, Gainwell hip (returned), others.
items.implication: Monday/Tuesday reports critical for next week rankings; CMC/Gainwell returned so less concern.
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation if any miss time.
